how: Re-recorded after the defect-100 unsized-numeric fix (type-system v1.3): an exact-numeric expression whose typmod the source engine drops (SUM/AVG/division over NUMERIC(10,2)) now stages as H2 DECFLOAT(100000) instead of DECIMAL(100000, 0), so staged totals keep their cents. Executed against the published mobility artifacts in an isolated stack (APP_COMPOSE_PROJECT=num100, APP_HOST_PORT=18100), through POST /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/execute with an author-scoped API key, every pipeline at its DEFAULT parameters. row_sha256 is sha256 over json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) of the full result page - one canonical encoding on both sides. Four pipelines moved: borough_od_matrix, airport_access_by_borough and weather_sensitivity_by_borough stage ROUND(SUM(...), 2) totals that previously truncated to whole dollars on insert, and mobility_briefing inherits the correction because it composes borough_od_matrix (PIPELINE node) and re-aggregates its now-exact totals in tempdb. Every other pipeline's hash is unchanged: check-baselines.sh went green on the pre-fix build against the previous file (all six matched) and on the fixed build against this file.
